We need to determine the crime(s) from facts. The case: Chen (defendant) signed sales cooperation agreement with Oumou company, ended Jan 31, stopped production of product. In November, Chen concealed that fact, still pretended to be Oumou company's distributor, demanded payment 24160 yuan from victim Li for purchase of product. Received money, never delivered goods, changed phone number to avoid contact. After incident, Chen returned all money and got victim's forgiveness.

This is a fraud case: obtaining money by false pretenses, i.e., "诈骗" (fraud). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "诈骗罪". The facts: misrepresenting as distributor, taking money, not delivering goods. That's typical fraud.
